Container.Name: minu
Container.Overview: A living dashboard for your Unraid server. Every container, VM and the server itself shows as dancing light. Sign in with a key or a passkey; open a terminal in any container. On first start the sign-in key is printed in the container log (click the container's icon, then Logs).

Config.Name: Settings and key
Config.Description: Holds your sign-in key (hashed), passkeys and the Unraid connection.

Config.Name: Docker socket (container terminals)
Config.Description: Lets minu open a shell inside a container. Remove it to turn terminals off.

Config.Name: Unraid address
Config.Description: Optional. The address of your Unraid web page, for example https://192.168.1.10. You can also enter it in minu's settings.

Config.Name: Unraid API key
Config.Description: Optional. Unraid, Settings, Management Access, API Keys. You can also enter it in minu's settings.

Config.Name: Root shell on the server (off)
Config.Description: Set to 1 to allow a root shell on Unraid itself from minu. Anyone signed in gets root, so turn on the authenticator code or a passkey first.

Config.Name: HTTPS certificate (optional)
Config.Description: Path inside the container to a certificate, for HTTPS. Needed for passkeys unless a reverse proxy or Tailscale provides HTTPS.

Config.Name: HTTPS key (optional)
Config.Description: Path inside the container to the certificate's private key.

Config.Name: Public address (optional)
Config.Description: Only behind a reverse proxy or Tailscale: the https address people use, for example https://minu.example.ts.net
